correctness.rationale: The group-algebra coefficient expansion is exact. Rank in the nonzero-linear case is half-dimension by filtered invertible coordinate change. In the quadratic case the parity/odd-dimension assertion, 2m-dimensional symplectic quadratic normal form, finite removal of all higher-order terms, and exact active-pair rank sum 4^m-2^m give an unrestricted proof. Exhaustive direct binary matrices corroborate 45 eligible parameter pairs through n=10. Square-zero/involution consequences follow from kernel dimension.

Originality is provisional against unindexed/partially inaccessible primary literature.
residual_risks: The complete Fish–Key–Mwambene 2009 primary PDF was not accessible; only its explicit scope in the repository abstract and Seneviratne 2016 introduction was available.
An unindexed older generalized association-scheme or commutative-algebra rank formula might imply the high-distance result; lack of a search hit is not uniqueness proof.
Scientific review is self-review, not an independent priority or correctness audit.
